_meta._comment_2: Written in Nastaʿlīq Urdu script (NOT romanized) so the RTL renderer flips correctly.
_meta._comment_3: Mattress = گدّا, stack = چٹاؤ/ڈھیر, unload = خالی کرنا, reject = مسترد کرنا.
_meta._comment_4: BOL kept as English literal (technical term carriers use); numerals are Western Arabic (0-9) per Pakistan business convention.
_meta._comment_5: Operator term = آپریٹر (loanword, common in industrial Pakistani Urdu).
